title: ASSISTANT ACCOUNTANT
description:
MEET THE EXPERTS!!!
 KLEVA Pharmaceuticals S.A. is a privately owned pharmaceutical company that has been in operation in Greece since 1974. Kleva develops and manufactures generic products and focus on Pharmaceuticals (Rx & OTC).
KLEVA has a fully integrated company with R&D, RA, Production, QC, QA, Marketing and Sales departments.
Our factory in Athens, Greece, is equipped with the latest technology machinery and has the manufacturing potential for a wide range of pharmaceutical forms.
Our mission is to offer a flexible, fully scalable, qualitative, and cost-effective product development in a wide range of dosage forms. We register and export our products to a number of regulated and non-regulated markets around the world.
To realize our ambitious goals, KLEVA needs people who are innovators, believe in the values of respect and cooperation and are ready to commit to a company that wants to penetrate new markets, leverage international business development opportunities, and enter contract manufacturing deals. 
How you will support our mission:
We are looking for an Assistant Accountant.
The ideal candidate will have a solid background in accounting/finance, as well as strong analytical and technical skills.
CANDIDATE PROFILE

A Bachelor degree in Accounting/Finance with a minimum of 5 years of accounting-related experience
Full proficiency in MS Office 
Proficient in English and Greek with good oral and written communication skills
Organizational & time management skills
Strong ability to work both independently and as part of a team
Strong work ethic, detail-oriented and committed to excellence
Confidentiality and integrity

 With DEI in mind!!! 
Diversity, equity, and inclusion are a priority for us! KLEVA ensures a safe and balanced working environment, based on respect by providing an equal number of opportunities to every employee who meets the necessary requirements.
Here @KLEVA, we care for your privacy. The security of your data is one of our greatest concerns. All information is strictly confidential and in accordance with GDPR rules.
 
                       Meet our hiring team…and apply now!!!!

title: Sales assistant Mango Flamingo Xanthi
description:
AXF S.A. 
 
 
Join our team! 
 
 
MANGO is a Spanish multinational company that specializes in women's fashion and has stores in more than 85 countries around the world.
We believe in a team that is dynamic, motivated and constantly growing. If you like to share responsibilities with others and contribute your knowledge and you are interested in both your professional and personal development, then you are one of us. Join the MANGO team and help us achieve our common objective: to be present in every city in the world.
 
At the moment we wish to hire suitable people for the position of sales advisor in the new MANGO store inside the FLAMINGO shopping center in Xanthi: 
 
 
                                                            Main Responsibilities  

Orientation to the result and the achievement of the store's goals
Promote the identity of the company's products
Maintain the highest level of customer service at all times
Keep the store neat and organized
Check and replace stock.

 
 
                                            Necessary Qualifications

To have personal motivation
Flexibility in communication and interpersonal relationships.
Team spirit of cooperation
High communication skills
Correct time management for the smooth operation of the store

 
 

 
 
 
SELLERS/SELLERS 
 
We are looking for a person who is self-motivated, able to work in a team, enthusiastic and outgoing and able to demonstrate high communication skills, with previous experience in the fashion industry and good market knowledge.
 
Your purpose will be to promote the company's product identity and consistently maintain the highest level of customer service. Your duties will also include keeping the store tidy and organized as well as checking and replacing stock.
 
 
Our priority is always to have our customers happy!

title: ACCOUNTING ASSISTANT
description:
